notes: Money is now rounded to exact cents at every write boundary - line totals, interest, sale and return totals, payments, expenses, interest accrual and LAN (mobile) amounts - so long running totals can never drift into 3-decimal float dust. Restoring a JSON backup now validates every row (unknown stores, missing ids, non-numeric money and re-injected numbers are refused before anything is wiped) and the renderer restore path ships through the same validated importer. New retention settings under Settings > Database: keep only the newest N manual backups and auto-delete audit logs older than a set number of days (both default to keep-everything). The Mobile Access window gained a Red rotate button - one click invalidates the current access code, kicks all connected phones and issues a fresh QR pair.
